destination.name: Suzhou
destination.tagline: Classical gardens, canal streets and silk heritage in the old Wu capital
destination.description: Suzhou is a city in Jiangsu famed for its classical gardens and traditional waterside architecture, with several gardens on the UNESCO list. It was the capital of the Kingdom of Wu and its walls date to the late 6th century BCE. Visitors pair the gardens with temples, pagodas, museums and restored canal streets in the old city, which is a rectangle about 6 by 3 km. Shanghai is under half an hour away by high-speed train.
whyVisit: Climb pagodas and visit old temples
Take a day trip to water towns

goodToKnow.title: Shanghai by fast train
goodToKnow.detail: Trains take under half an hour. Check your ticket says Hongqiao, not the old Shanghai Railway Station. Foreigners buy at the counter with a passport.

goodToKnow.title: Book Suzhou Museum ahead
goodToKnow.detail: Entry is free but a booking is needed in advance. Suzhou Museum West is the alternative if the main building is full.

goodToKnow.title: Summer heat and narrow pavements
goodToKnow.detail: Summers can reach 40 degrees and downtown pavements are narrow and clogged with parked scooters.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are mild for the gardens. Summers are hot and the wettest.
